This is a research-only task; do not write any code or files. Use the webfetch tool exactly once for each of the following two URLs (one call each, no retries):
1. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc20.txt
2. https://example.com/missing-page

Then report back in your final message, in one line per URL, what each webfetch call returned (e.g., success with a brief content summary, or the error/status message). Keep the report to exactly two lines.
